messages.subject: Execute access in app directory
parts:
Hi,
I am testing my app on shinyapps.io.
I noticed that part of my application doesn't work correctly which I think is due to lack of execute access in the app directory. At some point in the app, a text file is exported. I have a linux executable in the app directory which does some calculations on the exported text file and exports another text file. This is read back into the app. This part fails to work which I think might be due to lack of execute access. The app works fine locally on my desktop and on shiny-server setup. 

Is is possibly to look the directory permissions and/or change them?
Thanks,
Roy

Hi Roy,
I think I had seen that before, could you try to calling out from your application before the server portion and changing the permissions on your executable directly (through a system) call?  

-Tareef

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Execute access in app directory
parts:
Ah yes. That works! Thanks Tareef.

For the sake of completeness of this post,
The issue was not lack of execute permission in the app directory, but rather lack of permission on the linux executable.
I execute this

system("chmod 777 filename")

as the app loads and things work fine.
Thanks,
Roy
